title: Yellowed Yogic Indian Squid Gulab Jamun
description: A unique and flavorful Indian-inspired dish featuring squid, grilled to perfection and served in a sweet and spicy gulab jamun sauce, made with ayurvedic-sattvic friendly ingredients and cooked in a traditional tajine clay vessel.

ingredients.name: squid tubes
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: yakimono grill sauce
ingredients.notes: or substitute with a mixture of soy sauce and honey

instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium-high heat, or approximately 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the squid pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece to allow for even cooking.
Brush the squid with yakimono grill sauce and season with sea salt and turmeric powder.
Grill the squid for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through and slightly charred.
In a large bowl, mix together the gulab jamun mix, rose water, and cardamom powder.
Add the grilled squid to the bowl and toss to coat with the gulab jamun mixture.
Heat the ghee in a small saucepan over medium heat, or approximately 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Add the squid and gulab jamun mixture to the saucepan and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the sauce has thickened and the squid is fully coated.
Serve the Yellowed Yogic Indian Squid Gulab Jamun in a traditional tajine clay vessel, garnished with fresh cilantro and a sprinkle of cardamom powder.
